title: TOA Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TOA_Estimator.md
text: Estimate time of arrival, time-difference of arrival, and position, 5 inputs, 6 outputs; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {TOA/TDOA measurement} sets the measurement type, {TOA spectrum analysis method} sets the spectrum analysis method, {Enable known delay offset input} enables input of delay offsets, {Output variance of TOA/TDOA estimates} enables output variance of TOA/TDOA, {Output FFT-based TOA response} enables output of FFT-based TOA response, {Enable forward-backward averaging}, {Spatial smoothing}, {Output estimated target position} enables output of estimated target position, {Source of noise power}, {Noise power (W)} sets the gaussian white noise power and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
